facts.fact: INStaD published its yearbook of civil-status statistics for 2024 (births, marriages, deaths for all 77 communes, e.g. 468,570 births registered, 3,228 marriages, 9,707 deaths), compiled from the civil-registration database of ANIP; the figures cover 2024 and the yearbook is dated November 2025.

facts.fact: INStaD states it schedules a yearbook of civil-status statistics in its work plan every year, and that since 2023 its data come from the ANIP database; this 2024 edition is dated November 2025.
